description: Defines a builder class for constructing UCI PUCCH PDU Format 2, 3, or 4 messages, including methods to set various parameters such as format type, UE-specific parameters, metrics, SR, HARQ, and CSI parts.

classes.name: uci_pucch_pdu_format_2_3_4_builder
classes.description: Builder class for creating and configuring UCI PUCCH PDU Format 2, 3, or 4 messages.

methods.name: set_ue_specific_parameters
methods.description: Sets the UE-specific parameters for the PDU, including RNTI.

methods.name: set_format
methods.description: Sets the PDU format type (Format 2, 3, or 4).

methods.name: set_metrics_parameters
methods.description: Sets metrics parameters such as SINR, RSSI, and RSRP for the PDU.

methods.name: set_harq_parameters
methods.description: Sets HARQ detection status, expected bit length, and payload.

methods.name: set_csi_part1_parameters
methods.description: Sets CSI Part 1 detection status, bit length, and payload.

methods.name: set_csi_part2_parameters
methods.description: Sets CSI Part 2 detection status, bit length, and payload.
